options: Computers connected so they can send data to each other
A program that stores customer records
questions.why: A network is computers connected so they can send data to each other. Home Wi-Fi and the internet are networks.

options: The numeric address of a device on a network
A secret key for an API
questions.why: An IP address is the numeric address of a device, such as 203.0.113.10.

options: Turns names like api.example.com into IP addresses
questions.why: DNS is the internet's phone book: it turns names into IP addresses.

questions.q: What is the difference between HTTP and HTTPS?
options: HTTPS is HTTP encrypted so nobody on the path can read it
questions.why: HTTPS is HTTP encrypted with TLS.

options: Software that only runs on your laptop
Renting computing and storage from providers such as AWS, Azure and Google Cloud
A backup copy on a USB drive
questions.why: Cloud means renting computing, storage and services instead of owning the hardware.

options: Allows or blocks traffic by rules
questions.why: A firewall is a set of rules that allow or block traffic.

options: A web page people click on
Organized storage for records, often in tables
questions.why: A database is organized storage for records. Relational databases store data in tables you query with SQL.

questions.q: Which is the frontend of an application?
options: The part people see and click, such as a web page
The server code that talks to the database
questions.why: The frontend is what people see and click; the backend is the server-side code.

options: A plain-text format for structured data with names and values
questions.why: JSON is a plain-text format of names and values, used by almost every API.
Git records every change to code. A repository is a project folder with its full history.

options: A screen in a mobile app
An agreed way for one program to ask another for data or actions
questions.why: An API is an agreed way for one program to ask another for data or actions over the network.

options: A secret string that identifies your account when you call an API
questions.why: An API key is a secret that identifies your account, so keep it out of code and chats.

questions.q: What is a chat app, such as ChatGPT or the Claude app?
options: A finished product for people: you type, it answers
questions.why: A chat app is a finished product for people; developers use the API instead.

options: Software that does tasks we used to think needed human judgment
questions.why: AI is software that does tasks like reading, writing and recognizing images.

options: A large language model trained on a lot of text, such as Claude or GPT
questions.why: An LLM is a language model with billions of parameters, trained on a large amount of text.

options: The unit an LLM reads and writes: a word or part of a word
questions.why: A token is a word, part of a word or a punctuation mark. 100 tokens is about 75 words.

questions.q: A model confidently gives an answer that is false. What is this called?
questions.why: A hallucination is when a model states something false with confidence.

options: The browser window you chat in
The maximum amount of text a model can take in one request
The time of day the model works
questions.why: The context window is the maximum text, in tokens, the model can take in one request.

options: Information that identifies a person, such as name, email or phone
questions.why: Personal data identifies a person directly or indirectly.

questions.q: Where should API keys and passwords be kept?
options: In the code so it is easy to find
In a secret store or environment variables
In an email to the team
questions.why: Secrets go in a secret store or environment variables, never in code, documents or chats.
